children: Arcadis shares fell after Canadian engineering and infrastructure company WSP Global pulled its 4.435 billion euro ($5.08 billion) offer proposal for the Dutch company.
Arcadis shares were down 6% at 40.78 euros in early afternoon European trading, leading the Stoxx 600 index fallers. However, they are currently up 15% over the year to date.

WSP--which said in July that it proposed to buy Arcadis at 51.50 euros a share--said late Tuesday that it was unable to advance a transaction without engagement with the Dutch engineering consultancy's board.

Arcadis said in July that it rejected the approach as it undervalued the company's fundamentals and included an offer that was about half made up of WSP shares. It had previously rejected an offer proposal worth 48.50 euros a share from WSP.

Arcadis on Wednesday reaffirmed its rejection and said the boards remained fully committed to the strategic pillars as announced in its second quarter earnings. It said the board will provide an update on its medium-term strategy at its capital markets day on Sept. 29.
